Meta.title: Elona Keys
Meta.author: lIllIIlI
Meta.description: Classic Elona keybinds for Elin. Play with the keyboard instead of the mouse: e to eat, q to quaff, r to read, z to zap, g to get, d to drop, w to wear, o/c to open and close doors, p to pray, i to interact and more. All keys rebindable in BepInEx/config/elin.elonakeys.cfg.
